extraction.name: EgoLife Dataset
extraction.description: A comprehensive 300-hour egocentric, interpersonal, multiview, and multimodal daily life dataset with intensive annotation, designed to develop an egocentric life assistant.
extraction.creator: The EgoLife Team
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Six participants lived together for one week, continuously recording their daily activities using AI glasses for multimodal egocentric video capture, along with synchronized third-person-view video references from 15 cameras and 2 mmWave devices.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Physical data collection, Direct measurement, Experiments
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: First-person video from AI glasses (Meta Aria), third-person video from fixed indoor cameras (GoPro), and synchronized multimodal signal data including millimeter-wave radars and WiFi signals.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: Seven-day period (Beijing) and a one-day session (Milan).
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Data was synchronized using the EgoSync codebase. A rigorous data cleaning process was implemented for privacy protection (EgoBlur), blurring all identifiable faces, vehicle license plates, and sensitive screen content, and muting audio containing sensitive topics.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Videos were split into 5-minute clips and slowed to 0.8x speed for annotators to provide continuous narrations. Narrations were transcribed, merged using GPT-4o-mini, and expanded into visual-audio captions. For QA, GPT-4o generated candidate questions which were filtered and refined by human annotators to retain high-quality, long-context questions.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Capcut (video editing software with dubbing functions)
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Whisper Large v3, open-source diarization algorithm, GPT-4o-mini, GPT-4o
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset is an ongoing project with plans to expand to cover a broader range of languages, locations, and activities. The partnership with the annotation team will continue for future EgoLife versions.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Faces, vehicle license plates, private or potentially identifiable audio information, and sensitive screen content (e.g., passwords or personal data).
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Holds significant potential to enhance human-AI interaction, particularly in personalized assistance and context-aware applications, improving quality of life for individuals needing consistent support, such as the elderly or those with cognitive challenges.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Narrow setting with limited generalizability (e.g., single language/scenario). Models trained on it struggle with human laughter/emotions and identity recognition (overfitting to early observations).
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training multimodal egocentric AI assistants, evaluating long-context question answering (EgoLifeQA), human behavior recognition, multimodal signal analysis, and human-machine interaction.
